legend: A robot with the code name MAGD has type n%%ZSMJ0%%. To recharge, it requires a device with power p%%ZSMJ1%%, satisfying the conditions:
p≥n+1%%ZSMJ2%% (otherwise, the robot will not have enough power to recharge)
p≤n+k%%ZSMJ3%% (otherwise, the robot may burn out)

Among all suitable powers p%%ZSMJ4%%, we need to choose the one for which LCM(n%%ZSMJ5%%, p%%ZSMJ6%%) is minimized, so that the robot's battery lasts as long as possible. Given n%%ZSMJ7%% and k%%ZSMJ8%%, we need to compute p%%ZSMJ9%%.
LCM(a%%ZSMJ10%%,b%%ZSMJ11%%) is the least common multiple of the numbers a%%ZSMJ12%% and b%%ZSMJ13%%, that is, the smallest natural number that is divisible by both a%%ZSMJ14%% and b%%ZSMJ15%%.
input: Two numbers n%%ZSMJ16%% and k%%ZSMJ17%% are given, each on a separate line (1≤n≤1012%%ZSMJ18%%, 1≤k≤1012%%ZSMJ19%%)
output: You need to output the number p%%ZSMJ20%% — the required power of the device.

note: Note that the input data and the answer may exceed the range of possible values for a 32-bit integer variable, so it is necessary to use a 64-bit integer data type (type int64 in Pascal, type long long in C++, type long in Java and C#). In Python, no additional actions are required.
